description: This file contains TypeScript code for a TodoMVC application, including class definitions, AngularJS directives, services, and controller logic for managing todos.

classes.name: TodoItem
classes.description: Class representing a todo item with title and completion status.

classes.name: TodoStorage
classes.description: Service for persisting and retrieving todos from localStorage.

classes.name: TodoCtrl
classes.description: Main controller managing todo list, user interactions, and data binding.

methods.name: todoFocus
methods.description: Directive that focuses an element when a bound expression evaluates to true.

methods.name: todoBlur
methods.description: Directive that executes an expression when the element loses focus.

methods.name: todoEscape
methods.description: Directive that cancels editing on Esc key press.

methods.name: onPath
methods.description: Handles route changes to filter todos.

methods.name: doneEditing
methods.description: Completes editing a todo, saving or removing if empty.

methods.name: markAll
methods.description: Marks all todos as completed or active.
